answer: Reaching the garden of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
